case_quality_flags: Troponin I of 25 ng/mL is markedly elevated (>1000× upper limit of normal), consistent with large NSTEMI despite absence of persistent ST elevation on initial ECG

Aslanger pattern (ST elevation in III and aVR with ST depression in I, II, aVL, aVF, V2-V6) is a recognised NSTEMI-equivalent ECG pattern indicating multivessel or LMCA/RCA combined occlusion — neither candidate captures this specificity
